title: Daily Coverage Report
description: Production-style iDoXs Daily Coverage Report pivoting the selected period by day of month, with AP/UP/All under each day.

source.sql:
with base as (
  select coalesce(nullif(ltrim(rtrim(cast(d.REGION_ID as varchar(128)))), ''), '') as region_id,
         ltrim(rtrim(cast(pi.DISTRICT_ID as varchar(128)))) as district_id,
         ltrim(rtrim(cast(i.TERRITORY_ID as varchar(128)))) as territory_id,
         nullif(ltrim(rtrim(concat('(', ltrim(rtrim(cast(i.TERRITORY_ID as varchar(128)))), ')', isnull(p.LAST_NAME, ''), ', ', isnull(p.FIRST_NAME, '')))), '(),') as territory_name,
         datepart(day, i.VISIT_DATE) as visit_day,
         case when floor(convert(float, i.ITINERARY_DATE)) = floor(convert(float, i.VISIT_DATE)) then 1 else 0 end as ap,
         case when floor(convert(float, i.ITINERARY_DATE)) <> floor(convert(float, i.VISIT_DATE)) then 1 else 0 end as up,
         1 as all_calls
  from [dbo].[ITINERARY] i
  join [dbo].[PSR_ITINERARY] pi on i.ITINERARY_DATE = pi.ITINERARY_DATE and i.PSR_ID = pi.PSR_ID
  join [dbo].[PSR] p on i.PSR_ID = p.PSR_ID
  join [dbo].[PERIOD_DEFINITION] pd on pi.[MONTH] = pd.PERIOD_CODE and pi.[YEAR] = pd.FISCAL_YEAR
  left join [dbo].[TERRITORY] t on ltrim(rtrim(cast(i.TERRITORY_ID as varchar(128)))) = ltrim(rtrim(cast(t.TERRITORY_ID as varchar(128))))
  left join [dbo].[DISTRICT] d on ltrim(rtrim(cast(coalesce(t.DISTRICT_ID, pi.DISTRICT_ID) as varchar(128)))) = ltrim(rtrim(cast(d.DISTRICT_ID as varchar(128))))
  where pi.[MONTH] = @periodCode and pi.[YEAR] = @fiscalYear
    and i.VISIT_DATE is not null
    and i.VISIT_DATE between pd.START_DATE and dateadd(day, 1, pd.END_DATE)
    and isnull(ltrim(rtrim(cast(pi.PSR_ID as varchar(128)))), '') <> ''
    and pi.PSR_ID not like '%rr123%' and pi.PSR_ID not like '%rr143%'
    and i.TERRITORY_ID not in ('RRICT', 'TD', 'UNK')
    and pi.TERRITORY_ID not in ('RRICT', 'TL', '', '9999')
    and i.MD_ID not in (select MD_ID from [dbo].[DOCTOR] where SPECIALTY_CODE in ('DRG', 'PHR'))
    {{territoryPredicate:i.TERRITORY_ID}}
), aggregated as (
  select region_id, district_id, territory_id, territory_name,
         grouping(region_id) as g_region, grouping(district_id) as g_district,
         grouping(territory_id) as g_territory, grouping(territory_name) as g_territory_name,
         min(region_id) as __sort_region, min(district_id) as __sort_district, min(territory_id) as __sort_territory,
    cast(sum(case when visit_day = 1 then ap else 0 end) as int) as d01_ap,
    cast(sum(case when visit_day = 1 then up else 0 end) as int) as d01_up,
    cast(sum(case when visit_day = 1 then all_calls else 0 end) as int) as d01_all,
    cast(sum(case when visit_day = 2 then ap else 0 end) as int) as d02_ap,
    cast(sum(case when visit_day = 2 then up else 0 end) as int) as d02_up,

  from base
  group by grouping sets ((region_id, district_id, territory_id, territory_name), (region_id, district_id), (region_id), ())

select top 5000

  case when g_district = 1 then '' else isnull(district_id, '') end as district,
  case when g_region = 1 then '**** GRAND TOTAL ****'
       when g_district = 1 then concat('**** ', isnull(region_id, ''), ' sub-total')
       when g_territory = 1 then concat('**** ', isnull(district_id, ''), ' sub-total')

businessFormulas.label: AP / As Planned
businessFormulas.description: Visits where actual visit date is the same as planned itinerary date.
businessFormulas.formula: sum(case when floor(ITINERARY_DATE) = floor(VISIT_DATE) then 1 else 0 end)

businessFormulas.label: UP / Unplanned
businessFormulas.description: Visits where actual visit date is different from planned itinerary date.
businessFormulas.formula: sum(case when floor(ITINERARY_DATE) <> floor(VISIT_DATE) then 1 else 0 end)

businessFormulas.label: All
businessFormulas.description: Total covered visits for the day/group.
businessFormulas.formula: AP + UP, equivalent to count(*) over visited itinerary rows

scopeRules: exclude legacy test PSR ids rr143/rr123
dataSourceDefinition.grain: region + district + territory rows, pivoted by visit day with AP/UP/All measures
dataSourceDefinition.notes: Matches legacy rptDailyCoverageReport.php shape: Region/District grouping, Territory rows, day-of-month columns, AP/UP/All measures under each day, plus district/region/grand total rows. Uses PSR_ITINERARY.YEAR/MONTH for selected period and excludes legacy non-doctor/demo territory data.
